app_fee.value: International applicants pay $95 per program application.

fee_waiver.value: The Graduate School waiver is for US citizens and permanent residents; the fees page says fees cannot be waived.
fee_waiver.quote: Be a U.S. citizen or permanent resident

also.quote: Application fees cannot be waived or deferred, and are non-refundable.

gre_general.value: Set by each program; see the program record.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT total 4.5 on the new scale for tests taken on or after 21 Jan 2026 (79 on the old scale); programs may ask for more.
toefl_min.quote: For exams taken on or after January 21, 2026: | Total Score: 4.5

also.quote: For exams taken before January 21, 2026: | Total Score: 79

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall, with 6.5 in writing and reading; programs may ask for more.

english_waiver.value: India is not on the exemption country list, so Indian applicants need a test score unless they studied in a listed country.
english_waiver.quote: If you completed secondary school in the U.S. or in a country from the list below then you satisfy the basic English language proficiency requirements.

also.quote: The University of Minnesota requires all applicants to demonstrate English language proficiency (ELP).

notes: Graduate School program directory (apps.grad.umn.edu) returned 502, so fields were chosen from department sites.
